Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). * '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 6, file created 2 August 2024: “'''Light Side:''' During opponent's turn, if you occupy with a [Hoth] character or [Hoth] vehicle, may activate 1 Force. '''Dark Side:''' If you occupy, your Force generation is +1 here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (V)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (V)]] (published 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (LIGHT)”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
